findings.title: actual-factory-and-channeling-producer
findings.observation: 原生注册LIGHTNING_BOLT factory/noSave/0尺寸。trident先写dealtDamage并请求hurt；hurttrue且ENDERMAN提前return，否则正常路径减速后server+雷暴+channeling+目标位置可见天时create非null、设位置/cause并uncheckedadd，再换雷击声。hurtfalse不自动阻止该后续源请求；source add/声音非世界接纳或目标控制回执，producer/返回值支持0。

findings.title: autonomous-source-state
findings.observation: 构造life2、随机seed、flashes1..3、visualOnly默认false，独立cause ServerPlayer与hitEntities集合。source随后按自有tick推进，没有原trident/当前装备存续资格检查；cause不是目标伤害接纳。字段与随机数不拆信用。

findings.title: initial-side-effects-not-visual-only-blanket
findings.observation: life==2客户端请求雷声和撞击声；server按难度请求初始fire，再powerRod/clearCopper/gameEvent。visualOnly只在spawnFire内及server entity strike分支限制，不包围初始powerRod/copper/gameEvent或终止criterion。块/铜/rod机制归其它既有范围支持0，本轮不新增生态参考或全visualOnly无副作用结论。

findings.title: decrement-reset-and-active-same-tick
findings.observation: 先--life；负值且有flashes时在随机负阈值后--flashes、life=1、换seed并spawnFire0，之后同次仍可进life>=0的active分支。reset不是再写2，不会从此重进life==2初始声/块分支；默认初始2也先减为1再active。不是墙钟、固定所有调用次数或运行同步验收。

findings.title: per-active-pass-current-victim-list
findings.observation: ServerLevel且!visualOnly时，每active pass重新以x/z±3、y-3到y+9 AABB查询当前alive实体。选择谓词不查hitEntities，故集合不是每bolt一次去重伤害预算；同目标之后是否再被选/实际伤害依赖当前状态与接收链，不能宣称每pass必有damage或重复伤害漏洞。

findings.title: strike-event-local-denial
findings.observation: 每个已选目标post可取消strike事件，只有返回false才调entity.thunderHit。取消只抑制此caller的该调用，不自动回滚之前block/source动作，也不证明所有监听器都未产生效果。监听器discard bolt后本for没有本地removed/break检查，正常返回下仍可继续余项；事件异常/重入或旧EvilCraft版本效果未证明。

findings.title: attempt-union-not-damage-receipt
findings.observation: for正常完成后hitEntities.addAll(list1)，包含被strike事件取消的选择目标，不核thunderHit结果；cause非null还以同一list1发CHANNELED_LIGHTNING。该当前list可含先前过程中变化的实体，不是实际HP损失集合。之后再strike仍不按union排除；运行中异常可阻止addAll/criterion，不承诺事务。

findings.title: base-recipient-fire-before-hurt
findings.observation: 已读基类thunderHit先remainingFireTicks+1，若结果0再setSecondsOnFire8，随后hurt(lightningBolt,bolt.getDamage)且忽略bool；damage默认5且public可写。最终hurt拒绝不能反推之前未改火状态；虚子类/所有接收hooks未穷尽，不把基类泛化为所有target。

findings.title: terminal-bystanders-current-not-historical
findings.observation: life<0且flashes0时，server重查x/z±15、y-15到y+21的当前alive且不在hitEntities实体，向距bolt<256的当前玩家发LIGHTNING_STRIKE，再discard。bystanders不是初始附近名单，也不是“从未受伤”证明；cancelled但曾选择的目标已入union会被排除，死亡/移动会改变当前集合。

findings.title: criterion-consumer-and-listener-gates
findings.anchor: ChanneledLightningTrigger全文; LightningStrikeTrigger全文; SimpleCriterionTrigger全文
findings.observation: channel trigger将所给victims建context，每个要求predicate只需匹配某context；strike trigger先匹配bolt context，再ANY或任一当前bystander。SimpleCriterionTrigger还需已登记listener及player predicate通过，才run匹配listener。这里不查实际hurt/控制结果；触发调用不是所有任务已发奖、native拾取或进度验收，通用criterion支持0。

findings.title: subpredicate-current-alive-attempt-members
findings.observation: 实际拼写LighthingBoltPredicate按blocksSetOnFire范围及可选getHitEntities().anyMatch目标predicate；getHitEntities另过滤当前isAlive。它观察的仍是源记录的选择/尝试集合中当前存活者，不是最终受伤者。一个predicate集合匹配不是为目标提交拒控或证实命中。

findings.title: fire-count-is-request-counter
findings.observation: spawnFire受!visualOnly、server和DOFIRETICK，要求air与fire能存活后setBlockAndUpdate并无视返回即++blocksSetOnFire；随机周边同样。故计数表示该源码路径尝试写火，不能独立保证最终实际火块数/保持状态/付款或生态验收；block helpers0额外。

findings.title: visual-only-and-termination-selection
findings.observation: visualOnly阻止server strike list分支，因而本体通常不由该分支填hitEntities，但不跳终止bystander/玩家criterion；动态setter可改变后续分支。不据名字声称纯视觉与零准入/进度副作用，实际配置/改旗时序仍未运行。

findings.title: client-construction-and-generic-packet-boundary

findings.title: autonomous-source-state
findings.observation: 构造life2、随机seed、flashes1..3、visualOnly默认false，独立cause ServerPlayer与hitEntities集合。source随后按自有tick推进，没有原trident/当前装备存续资格检查；cause不是目标伤害接纳。字段与随机数不拆信用。

findings.title: initial-side-effects-not-visual-only-blanket
findings.observation: life==2客户端请求雷声和撞击声；server按难度请求初始fire，再powerRod/clearCopper/gameEvent。visualOnly只在spawnFire内及server entity strike分支限制，不包围初始powerRod/copper/gameEvent或终止criterion。块/铜/rod机制归其它既有范围支持0，本轮不新增生态参考或全visualOnly无副作用结论。

findings.title: decrement-reset-and-active-same-tick

complete_four_business.full_chain_observation:
registered item/custom entity/event: Actual EvilCraft config list creates normal and empowered InvertedPotentia, lightning grenade and item_empowerable entity. ItemConfig/EntityConfig shared factories and register/getRender pipeline reused exactly. New CommonProxy.registerEventHooks registers EntityStruckByLightningEventHook; ClientProxy constructs delegated CommonProxy and Core ClientProxyComponent forwards registerEventHooks. Existing ModBase setup calls actual selected proxy. No explicit server guard in empowerItem hook itself; native event dispatch/thread not inferred from grenade source.
actual lightning producer and attempt cues: ItemAbstractGrenade.use server shrinks1 unless creative, calls ARROW_SHOOT then actual getThrowableEntity→EntityLightningGrenade, shoots andaddFreshEntity ignoring result; returns SUCCESS helper on both sides. Impact ENTITY calls hurt(thrown,0) without checking result; server with ServerPlayer owner calls EntityHelpers.onEntityCollided→block.stepOn, creates LightningBolt, positions at grenade coordinates, requests add ignoringresult, then discards grenade. Other serverowners still discard without bolt. Client onHit emits32CRIT without proving bolt/empowerment. No nullbolt/rollback/receipt; native collision/strike dispatch unexpanded.
concrete conversion and event termination: Hook receives ItemEntity with IItemEmpowerable and !isEmpowered, calls empower then entity.setItem(result), cancels strike event, discards lightning. Concrete InvertedPotentia.empower creates new empowered registered ItemStack with old count, doesnot copy tags/caps/name/damage. Predicate is finalboolean on item type, not mutable perstackNBT. No owner/weather/samebolt set or damage-result precondition in item branch. Already empowered skips replacement, cancel and bolt removal. Sameentity repeated event after successful replacement sees new true state; no universal oneitem-perbolt claim because native iteration after remove notread.
custom dropped entity construction and current predicate: Both Potentia types hasCustomEntitytrue; createEntity casts locationItemEntity and creates EntityItemEmpowerable(world,original), ignoring separate itemStack parameter. Extended original constructor sets pickupDelay40, copies motion/position and original stack reference before Indestructable.init. It doesnot explicitly copy original age/owner/thrower/pickupdelay. isIndestructable reads current item everyquery: IItemEmpowerable uses its isEmpowered, otherwise supertrue. isInvulnerableTo returns that OR super. fireImmune always true independent of empowerment. Hook accepts any ItemEntity, so conversion doesnot itself guarantee custom subclass or this protection override was installed.
construction-selected lifetime stays separate: Indestructable.init calls virtual isUndespawnable, which defaults to isIndestructable, and only then sets lifespan Integer.MAX_VALUE when true. Original ordinary Potentia is set before init, so false doesnot request this lifetime override; empowered originaltrue requestsMAX. Later lightning entity.setItem switches live protection predicate but invokes no init/age/lifespan reset. Re-dropping an empowered item through customconstructor can selectMAX. Default type/world constructor and clientcopy construct before caller assigns finalstack; exact initial native ItemEntity stack and native load/lifespan decode are unexpanded, so no asserted load-time infinity. Undespawnable sibling forces lifespan branchtrue but isIndestructablefalse while fireImmune remainstrue; whole sibling only support0.
actual feedback consumer and end limits: InvertedPotentia.isFoil delegates to isEmpowered; entity config registers native ItemEntityRenderer, and Extended.getAddEntityPacket delegates to NetworkHooks. Client copy creates bytype then copies stack andposition but notage fields (commented). These are actual mod presentation inputs, not native tracked-stack/renderer/foil delivery proof. No dedicated item refusal/upgrade message/sound/particle receipt or cooldown. Arrow sound precedes projectile acceptance and CRIT derives localimpact. Permanent item type state has no de-empower/timedreset in these classes. Pickup/merge/despawn/removal remain inherited native paths not expanded; damage predicate true is not proof every native source/removal is denied.
complete_four_business.concrete_observation: Generic lightning cancellation already Wizardry; retained hurt-vs-lifetime state split differs from timed vulnerability, actor/statue replacement, spirit freeze, observer cleanup and current-stack wear clamp. Whole dropped-item type conversion changes live protection while old construction-selected lifetime stays; metadata loss and native presentation inputs are supporting0. Existing Werewolf transformation and Crafter NBT schema/upgrade remain old migration owners0extra.
complete_four_business.application_to_boss_immune: Separate protection derived from live payload from constructor-only lifetime settings. When replacing contents in place, explicitly decide whether lifetime and ownership should change; distinguish attempted conversion cues from authoritative success.
